card.name: Commas and digits inside number lists
card.fires_on: Punctuation or digits inside a run of numbers, such as the comma in a sequence like 4, 18, 81, a hyphen in an isotope name, or a digit within a range. Also a few verbs of gradual change like decrease or change.

modes.label: Separators in number sequences
modes.description: A comma between terms of a listed numeric sequence.

modes.label: Digits inside ranges and values
modes.description: A digit or decimal point inside a confidence interval or list of times.

modes.label: Change verbs
modes.description: Verbs like decrease or change describing something varying over time.
modes.example: time to onset may<< decrease>> with repeat administration of contrast agent

card.writes: It suppresses words like gradually and increasingly, so it holds back adverbs of gradual change.
card.plain: It fires on commas and digits inside strings of numbers, and slightly on verbs of change.
